versionScheme.name: calver-isoweek
versionScheme.description: YY = the two-digit ISO week-YEAR (%G, not the calendar year -- 2027-01-02 is ISO week 53 of week-year 2026, so that date is 26.53.x). WW = the ISO week (%V), printed without zero-padding since semver forbids a leading zero. N = 0 for the Saturday release, incremented for an out-of-band release later in the same ISO week.

outOfBandPolicy.description: Reserved for a security fix, or a fix for a release that already shipped broken -- never for an ordinary content change that simply missed Friday's merge window. A changeset carrying `release: out-of-band` in its frontmatter needs explicit owner approval before the release PR that consumes it merges.
